summary_md: **Xindi Yang ([@Madaoer_Yxd](https://x.com/Madaoer_Yxd/status/2115419888361820607))** describes **Oneira**, where a coding agent maintains an explicit world state while a video model renders pixels, so interactions persist over long horizons in video world models; the project page has details.

referenced_urls.title: Oneira: From Open-Ended Generation to Open-World Interaction in Video World Models

relevance: Agent-maintained state plus generative rendering: a recipe for persistent interactive worlds.

media.description: Oneira pipeline figure: an input image with the goal 'Pick up the lower left apple', a coding agent planning actions and writing a world-state table, an engine rendering a coarse conditioning video along a camera path, and a video generation model producing the final segment.
